title: Independent changelog↔diff validator + form/schema-compat gate
design_note: Pure-core stateless validator that independently recomputes the bundle diff (without calling deriveSemanticChangelog) and verifies the producer's claimed changelog against it, catching omissions, spurious entries, and kind mismatches. Also validates form_json_schema well-formedness and runs classifySchemaChange for schema-compat (lossy/destructive changes → blocked; soft narrowings → warnings). No migration needed — the validator is a pure function, no persistence.

files_changed.role: NEW — pure-core independent validator (zero-dep, no node:crypto, no env/fs/http/pg/Date.now/Math.random)
NEW — 24 unit tests covering all required scenarios (omission → blocked, lossy schema → blocked, faithful changelog + additive → promote-safe, etc.)
UPDATED — appended changelog-diff-validator-isolation.sh && --self-test to the END of the fitness script (additive)

independent_recompute_anti_tautology: diffBundleSnapshots() re-implements the diff independently by comparing raw BundleSnapshot string fields directly (Set/Map-based presence+content check). It does NOT import or call deriveSemanticChangelog from bundle-commit.ts. The claimed changelog is then verified against the independently-computed ActualChange[] — any omission, spurious entry, or kind mismatch surfaces as a hard failure. FF-CDV-3 in the fitness check enforces this: grep on code lines must not find any call to deriveSemanticChangelog.
